user.title: Frost Risks
user.description: Choose one weather entity, or both temperature and humidity sensors. Individual sensors override only their corresponding weather value. Use weather for the same location as the surface. Optional rain/snow inputs must describe current precipitation, not lifetime totals. Outputs are advisory and never control a device.
